mapper.insert: insert into batch.trigger_misfire_pending ( tenant_id, workflow_definition_id, job_code, scheduled_fire_time, detected_at, status, expires_at, created_at, updated_at ) values ( #{entity.tenantId}, #{entity.workflowDefinitionId}, #{entity.jobCode}, #{entity.scheduledFireTime}, now(), #{initialStatus}, #{entity.expiresAt}, now(), now() ) on conflict (tenant_id, workflow_definition_id, scheduled_fire_time) do nothing
mapper.select: select pending.* from batch.trigger_misfire_pending pending join batch.trigger_request request on request.id = pending.catch_up_request_id and request.tenant_id = pending.tenant_id and request.workflow_definition_id = pending.workflow_definition_id where pending.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and request.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and request.request_id = #{requestId} order by pending.id desc limit 1
mapper.update: update batch.trigger_misfire_pending set catch_up_request_id = #{catchUpRequestId}, updated_at = now() where id = #{id}

with expired as ( update batch.trigger_misfire_pending p set status = #{targetPendingStatus}, updated_at = now() where p.status = 'PENDING' and p.expires_at <= #{now} and ( p.catch_up_request_id is null or exists ( select 1 from batch.trigger_request tr where tr.id = p.catch_up_request_id and tr.tenant_id = p.tenant_id and tr.request_status = 'ACCEPTED' ) ) returning p.tenant_id, p.workflow_definition_id, p.scheduled_fire_time, p.catch_up_request_id ), rejected_request as ( update batch.trigger_request tr set request_status = #{targetRequestStatus}, updated_at = now() from expired e where tr.id = e.catch_up_request_id and tr.tenant_id = e.tenant_id and tr.request_status = 'ACCEPTED' returning tr.tenant_id, tr.request_id ) update batch.scheduled_occurrence so set occurrence_status = #{targetOccurrenceStatus}, updated_at = now() from expired e where so.tenant_id = e.tenant_id and so.workflow_definition_id = e.workflow_definition_id and so.scheduled_fire_time = e.scheduled_fire_time and so.occurrence_status = 'MISFIRE_PENDING'

with rejected as ( update batch.trigger_misfire_pending p set status = #{targetPendingStatus}, approved_by = a.approver_id, approved_at = coalesce(a.updated_at, now()), rejection_reason = coalesce(a.approval_reason, 'Rejected by central approval'), updated_at = now() from batch.trigger_request tr cross join batch.approval_command a where a.tenant_id = tr.tenant_id and a.target_id = tr.request_id and a.approval_type = 'CATCH_UP' and a.target_type = 'CATCH_UP' and a.approval_status = 'REJECTED' and p.tenant_id = tr.tenant_id and p.catch_up_request_id = tr.id and p.status = 'PENDING' and tr.request_status = 'ACCEPTED' returning p.tenant_id, p.workflow_definition_id, p.scheduled_fire_time, p.catch_up_request_id ), rejected_request as ( update batch.trigger_request tr set request_status = #{targetRequestStatus}, updated_at = now() from rejected r where tr.id = r.catch_up_request_id and tr.tenant_id = r.tenant_id and tr.request_status = 'ACCEPTED' returning tr.tenant_id, tr.request_id ) update batch.scheduled_occurrence so set occurrence_status = #{targetOccurrenceStatus}, updated_at = now() from rejected r where so.tenant_id = r.tenant_id and so.workflow_definition_id = r.workflow_definition_id and so.scheduled_fire_time = r.scheduled_fire_time and so.occurrence_status = 'MISFIRE_PENDING'

with approved as ( update batch.trigger_misfire_pending p set status = #{targetPendingStatus}, approved_by = a.approver_id, approved_at = coalesce(a.approved_at, a.updated_at, now()), updated_at = now() from batch.trigger_request tr join batch.approval_command a on a.tenant_id = tr.tenant_id and a.target_id = tr.request_id and a.approval_type = 'CATCH_UP' and a.target_type = 'CATCH_UP' and a.approval_status in ('APPROVED', 'EXECUTED') where p.tenant_id = tr.tenant_id and p.catch_up_request_id = tr.id and p.status = 'PENDING' returning p.tenant_id, p.workflow_definition_id, p.scheduled_fire_time, tr.request_id ) update batch.scheduled_occurrence so set occurrence_status = #{targetOccurrenceStatus}, request_id = coalesce(a.request_id, so.request_id), updated_at = now() from approved a where so.tenant_id = a.tenant_id and so.workflow_definition_id = a.workflow_definition_id and so.scheduled_fire_time = a.scheduled_fire_time and so.occurrence_status = 'MISFIRE_PENDING'
